reviews.ownership_check: The A2A Protocol project remains the official authority for the versioned A2A specification.
reviews.finding: A2A 1.0.0 is now the latest released specification. It adds explicit major-minor negotiation, functional equivalence across JSON-RPC, gRPC, and HTTP+JSON bindings, task listing and subscription operations, signed and cached Agent Cards, in-task authorization signaling, and documented breaking migrations. Its normative data objects come from the versioned protocol definition rather than the rendered convenience artifact.
reviews.action: Replace the mutable latest link with the versioned 1.0.0 specification. Add binding-equivalence, normative-schema, signed-discovery, authorization-scope, downgrade, and breaking-migration checks while preserving the rule that protocol support is not observed interoperability.

reviews.ownership_check: Agent Skills specification site remains the named open-format authority.
reviews.finding: The current page still requires a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter, a matching lowercase name of at most 64 characters, a description of at most 1024 characters, and string-valued metadata. It retains optional compatibility metadata, focused relative references, progressive disclosure, and experimental allowed-tools. No current specification change requires a canonical skill change.
reviews.action: Refresh the reviewed content marker. Keep allowed-tools out of canonical skills, preserve ASCII names, and retain regression coverage for name, description, metadata, and frontmatter limits.

reviews.ownership_check: HashiCorp Developer remains the official Terraform language documentation.
reviews.finding: The current language page identifies Terraform 1.15 as latest and 1.16 as a release candidate, and it includes resources, data sources, modules, state, stacks, testing, import, and compatibility material. The profile already discovers repository versions and refuses a universal command or apply authority.
reviews.action: Refresh the source marker. Keep the profile version-neutral and require repository-pinned version discovery.

reviews.ownership_check: GitHub Docs remains the official authority for pull request reviews.
reviews.finding: The current page still separates comment, approve, and request-changes decisions. It says anyone with read access can review and comment, requesting a review requires write access, organization members with write or triage permission can assign reviewers, CODEOWNERS can request review automatically, and administrators can require approvals. The review skills already separate proposal, review, merge, and external-write authority.
reviews.action: Use GitHub's official Markdown representation for a stable authority-content marker. No skill instruction change is required.

reviews.ownership_check: The Python Software Foundation remains the publisher of the official Python documentation.
reviews.finding: The floating Python 3 page still resolves to Python 3.14.7 after its August 25 documentation rebuild. It continues to link the language, library, setup, packaging, deprecation, and static typing authorities. The profile already requires discovery of the repository-pinned interpreter and does not assume a universal version or command.
reviews.action: Refresh the rebuilt page marker. Keep version-sensitive guidance tied to repository evidence; no skill instruction change is required.

reviews.ownership_check: The Python Software Foundation remains the publisher of the unittest reference.
reviews.finding: The Python 3.14.7 unittest page was rebuilt on August 25. It still grounds tests in self-contained cases, observable assertions, fixtures, isolation, discovery behavior, and explicit skipped or expected-failure states. The test-quality workflow remains framework-neutral and compatible.
reviews.action: Refresh the rebuilt page marker. No skill instruction change is required.

reviews.ownership_check: The Git project documentation remains the official git-merge authority.
reviews.finding: The current documentation preserves merge abort and continue behavior and warns that dirty pre-merge work may not be reconstructable. The conflict workflow already inspects exact state, keeps abort visible, and avoids destructive cleanup.
reviews.action: Refresh the source marker. No skill instruction change is required.

reviews.ownership_check: The Git project documentation remains the official git-worktree authority.
reviews.finding: The linked-worktree model, shared repository state, removal rules, and incomplete submodule support remain consistent with the current workflow and focused reference.
reviews.action: Refresh the source marker. No skill instruction change is required.

reviews.ownership_check: OpenAI ChatGPT Learn remains the official documentation surface for Codex and ChatGPT subagents.
reviews.finding: The current page distinguishes ChatGPT Work from local Codex clients; documents direct or instruction-driven delegation; describes surface-specific thread inspection; allows eligible Ultra sessions to delegate suitable work proactively; and emphasizes independent work, higher token cost, and caution with parallel writes. It now documents inherited permission and sandbox behavior, custom-agent configuration layers, per-agent overrides, MCP and skill configuration, concurrency controls, and legacy configuration aliases in greater detail.
reviews.action: Update the client mapping to require exact surface, account capability, model, reasoning level, permission mode, custom-agent configuration, registered tools, and version evidence. Preserve the portable authorization, ownership, cost, and reconciliation boundaries, then refresh the marker.

reviews.ownership_check: The OWASP Gen AI Security Project remains the publisher of the Agentic Security Initiative.
reviews.finding: The initiative page now highlights additional 2026 governance, Agentic Top 10, MCP server, third-party MCP, and security landscape resources. These expand the supporting resource index but do not replace exact threat evidence, application controls, skill-package review, or system-specific testing.
reviews.action: Refresh the source marker. Keep the system-wide threat domains, MCP and protocol boundaries, and explicit no-certification language; no skill instruction change is required.

reviews.ownership_check: The OWASP Gen AI Security Project remains the named publisher of the vector and embedding risk guidance.
reviews.finding: The current guidance continues to cover unauthorized access, cross-context leakage, federation conflicts, poisoning, and permission-aware isolation. It also calls out embedding inversion and retrieval-driven behavior changes, which were not explicit in the first workflow draft.
reviews.action: Add embedding-confidentiality and intended-behavior checks to the retrieval review, keep retrieved content untrusted, and refresh the stable normalized marker.

reviews.ownership_check: The OpenTelemetry project remains the official authority for its signal model.
reviews.finding: The current page still identifies traces, metrics, logs, and baggage while describing profiles as developing. The observability workflow uses logs, metrics, traces, correlation context, privacy, and cost controls without claiming unsupported telemetry.
reviews.action: Refresh the source marker. No skill instruction change is required.

reviews.ownership_check: Google for Developers is the official publisher of the individual-user transition announcement.
reviews.finding: Individual free, Google AI Pro, and Google AI Ultra users moved from Gemini CLI to Antigravity CLI, while qualifying enterprise and paid Agent Platform users retain conditional Gemini CLI access.
reviews.action: Use Antigravity CLI as the primary future Google developer-client key, preserve Gemini CLI evidence as historical, and require an intentionally in-scope enterprise license for future Gemini CLI compatibility observations.

reviews.ownership_check: Google Antigravity documentation is the official authority for Antigravity skill discovery and invocation.
reviews.finding: Antigravity documents workspace Agent Skills, progressive loading, implicit discovery, and slash invocation. No reviewed control was found that proves an explicit-only model-invocation policy equivalent to the Codex or Claude projection.
reviews.action: Add a surface-specific discovery slot, block the seven-skill profile because it contains publish-change-safely, and require live evidence before claiming explicit-only parity.

reviews.ownership_check: Google Antigravity documentation is the official authority for its native CLI plugin manifest.
reviews.finding: The documented Antigravity native plugin manifest and MCP configuration filenames differ from the Agent Plugins 1.0 package schema.
reviews.action: Keep Antigravity-native packaging separate and do not claim that a portable Agent Plugins package is accepted without a conformant-client observation.

reviews.ownership_check: The Agent Plugins specification site is the named authority for the portable Agent Plugins 1.0 package format.
reviews.finding: Agent Plugins 1.0 defines portable packaging around plugin.json and mcp.json but does not establish a client's sandbox, credential, permission, provenance, or installation-trust behavior.
reviews.action: Defer a minimal skills-only proof package until a selected conformant client is tested, and keep packaging claims separate from security and behavior.

reviews.ownership_check: Google Antigravity documentation is the official authority for headless CLI output and result behavior.
reviews.finding: Headless execution exposes structured output and tool events, and permission denials can be represented inside an otherwise continuing run.
reviews.action: Require terminal-result and tool-event parsing; never grade an Antigravity case from process exit code alone.

reviews.ownership_check: Google AI for Developers is the official authority for Gemini API Managed Agents.
reviews.finding: Managed Agents are hosted sandboxed agent runs with separate tools, source mounting, retention, and a documented range of 100,000 to 3 million tokens per interaction.
reviews.action: Keep Managed Agents out of the initial quantitative pilot; begin with synthetic public cases, explicit tool policy, a preregistered cost ceiling, and retention and environment-deletion records.

reviews.ownership_check: Google Cloud documentation is the official authority for Data Agent Kit status and capabilities.
reviews.finding: Data Agent Kit is a Preview vendor skill and tool layer for Google data services and compatible coding agents.
reviews.action: Treat it as an optional tool/plugin compatibility lane; do not let vendor skills define product semantics, registry authority, deployment approval, or evaluation truth.

reviews.ownership_check: Google AI for Developers is the official authority for current Gemini model availability and pricing qualifications.
reviews.finding: Gemini 3.8 Flash is documented as generally available, with introductory pricing ending December 31, 2026. Model availability, pricing, and effort behavior are volatile execution-envelope facts.
reviews.action: Keep model choice out of static skill instructions, read current release and deprecation records before an experiment, and compare cost per successful case.

reviews.ownership_check: Google Antigravity documentation is the official authority for the Antigravity SDK harness.
reviews.finding: The SDK exposes a programmatic agent harness but remains a distinct runtime surface from the CLI even when implementation components are shared.
reviews.action: Create SDK evidence only in a separate runtime-harness lane after a useful CLI treatment exists.

reviews.ownership_check: Google for Developers is the official publisher of the Agents CLI lifecycle announcement.
reviews.finding: Agents CLI supports agent evaluation, infrastructure preparation, and deployment lifecycle operations, which carry different authority and evidence requirements from coding-assistant behavior.
reviews.action: Treat it as lifecycle tooling; require explicit RELEASE authority for infra, deploy, and publish operations plus provider readback.

reviews.ownership_check: Google Cloud documentation is the official authority for Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform architecture.
reviews.finding: The platform provides production runtime, identity, governance, memory, evaluation, observability, registry, gateway, and orchestration capabilities beyond a local coding client.
reviews.action: Keep product and runtime claims in their own evidence lane and never blend them with skill behavioral results.
